meta.notes: NEW WIDER GRID (76x60, N63.62 S63.18 W12.80 E13.45). species_class and is_forest derived from Naturvardsverket NMD 2018 basskikt raster, sampled by WMS GetFeatureInfo at each grid-cell CENTER (single 10 m pixel per cell; not a majority vote). nmd_code = raw NMD basskikt class code (see nmd_code_labels). is_forest=1 for standing forest classes (species 1-4,6); clearcut/regenerating 'Temporart ej skog' (118/128) is species_class=5 with is_forest=0 (forest land use but currently treeless). Landcover coverage is COMPLETE: 0 nulls across all 4560 cells, 0 fetch errors. || CANOPY: tree height added from NMD Objekthojd 5-45 m tall-object height. Encoding: pixel value = upper edge of a 5 m height bin in METRES (10='5-10 m',15='10-15 m',...,45='40-45 m'); nodata=255 means no >=5 m object (open land, clearcut, water, alpine read as nodata). Unlike the center-pixel landcover sample, canopy is aggregated over ALL 10 m pixels inside each cell footprint (~58x54 px): tall_cover_frac = fraction (0..1) of the cell's pixels carrying a >=5 m object (canopy/maturity density; 0 nulls); tree_height_mean_m = MEAN height of those tall pixels in the cell (null where the cell has NO >=5 m object; 4226/4560 non-null). Heights are 5 m-quantized (subtract ~2.5 m for bin midpoints). No 'volume/basal-area' layer: the Skogsstyrelsen Skogliga grunddata service requires Basic auth (not attempted).
